title: Seven Falls and Garden of the Gods
blurb:
Experience the best of Colorado’s natural beauty with a day of waterfalls, red rock formations, and a picnic in the great outdoors.

Your adventure begins at Seven Falls, a stunning series of cascading waterfalls tucked into a towering box canyon. Climb the 224 steps to the top for breathtaking views, explore scenic walking trails, or simply admire the falls from the base. After soaking in the beauty of this hidden gem, we’ll set up a well-appointed picnic lunch in a peaceful outdoor setting, complete with fresh, locally prepared fare.

Next, we’ll head to the iconic Garden of the Gods, where you can choose between a scenic sightseeing drive with picture-perfect stops or a guided hike through the towering red rock formations. Whether you’re capturing photos of the stunning landscape or immersing yourself in the park’s rich history and geology, this experience offers the perfect mix of adventure, relaxation, and Colorado’s most awe-inspiring scenery.
